evidence: New Resume created blank editor with empty contact, summary (0/500), empty experience/education lists, empty skills; editing began immediately.

issue: No validation for invalid date ranges
actual: Set experience end-date (2019-06) before start-date (2020-01); no error message or rejection occurred. The invalid entry was accepted and rendered in the preview as 'Jan 2020 - Jun 2019' with no warning/feedback.

evidence: Both start-date and end-date use type=month inputs (consistent MM/YYYY format). Checking 'I currently work here' cleared end-date value to '' and disabled the field (enabled:false); unchecking re-enabled it.

Entered/edited contact fields and summary; added/edited/reordered/removed experience and education entries (move-up/down toggled enabled state correctly, remove worked); added/changed level/removed skills (JavaScript level changed to Expert, React added and removed).

Switched Modern -> Classic -> Minimal via Template tab; each switch updated preview styling (heading case, formatting) immediately while all contact/summary/experience/education/skills content remained intact.
Preview updated instantly after each field edit (contact fields) and each template selection change, with no save/refresh action performed.

Renamed Experience section heading to 'Career History' via Sections tab; verified it appears (styled per-template casing) in Minimal ('CAREER HISTORY'), Modern ('Career History'), and Classic ('CAREER HISTORY') previews.

Moved Skills section above Education via move-up; preview order updated to Contact, Summary, Career History, Skills, Education. Toggled Education visibility off; section disappeared from preview, then toggled back on and it reappeared.

Reorder and visibility toggle both reflected immediately in the preview; after navigating to Contact tab and back to Sections tab, order (contact, summary, experience, skills, education) and visibility states remained unchanged.

Clicked 'Hide Preview' - preview region disappeared and toggle label changed to 'Show Preview'. Clicked again - preview reappeared with all contact/summary/experience/skills/education content intact and selected template still 'Classic'.

Added 6 experience entries with long descriptions causing content to exceed the visible preview area (page grew to ~2900px vs 720px viewport). All sections (summary, career history x6, skills, education) render with correct content, and every heading/entry remained reachable and fully readable by scrolling (verified 'State University' education entry visible at scrollY=300); no content was clipped.

issue: No validation feedback on empty/whitespace rename
actual: Attempted to rename resume title to whitespace-only ('   ') and pressed Enter. The title correctly reverted to the previous value 'Untitled Resume' (not saved), but no error message, toast, or any validation feedback was shown to the user; both notification regions remained empty.

evidence: Renamed resume from 'Untitled Resume' to 'QA Test Resume' in editor; title updated in editor header, and dashboard card for the resume (key gbaf6hgddmr) shows the same title 'QA Test Resume'.

Navigated away to dashboard and reopened 'QA Test Resume'; contact fields, summary, experience (Acme Corp/Software Engineer), education (State University), and skills (JavaScript, React) all remained present exactly as entered.

Edits (contact info, renamed sections, renamed resume title) persisted automatically without an explicit save action. Returning to the dashboard showed the resume's updated title and 'Updated Aug 26, 2026' timestamp reflecting the recent edit; reopening the resume restored all edited content.
Duplicated 'QA Test Resume' -> created 'QA Test Resume (Copy)'; renamed via dialog to 'QA Test Resume - Marketing Version'; edited its full-name field independently of the source resume.

Edited copy's full-name to 'Alex Tester (Copy Edited)' - original remained 'Alex Tester'. Then edited original's full-name to 'Alex Tester (Original Edited)' - reopened copy and confirmed it still showed 'Alex Tester (Copy Edited)', unaffected.

Dashboard shows 5 distinct resume variations created/managed during the session (QA Test Resume, its renamed duplicate, plus 3 pre-existing), each independently editable with its own title, template, and content.

Searching lowercase 'marketing' matched both 'Marketing Manager Resume' and 'QA Test Resume - Marketing Version' (case-insensitive). Sort toggled between Newest First and Oldest First correctly reordered the 2 filtered results by date. Clearing the search restored all 5 resumes.

actual: Dashboard only offers a title search box and a sort dropdown (Newest/Oldest/Title A-Z/Z-A). No control exists to filter resumes by an exact creation date or a date range (no date picker, date inputs, or similar UI element found in the full accessibility snapshot).

Created 'QA Test Resume' (edited with contact/experience/education/skills/section changes), duplicated it, renamed the duplicate, and deleted the duplicate. After reloading the application (navigating to the same URL), the dashboard reverted to only the original 3 seed resumes (Software Engineer Resume, Marketing Manager Resume, Product Designer Resume); the created resume and all associated edits, duplication, rename, and deletion were lost entirely.
